World.create: Creates a grid of cells; cellSize is measured in pixels.
World.numberOfObjects: Number of actors in this world.
World.isClicked: Whether the world itself was clicked.
World.show: Displays this world and pauses the simulation.
World.act: Override to define what happens on each step.
World.addObject: Places an actor at (x, y); moves it from its previous world.
World.allObjects: A copy of the list of all actors.
World.setBackground: Sets the background from an image file or RGB color.
World.showText: Text at (x, y); an empty string removes it.
World.summary: A grid of cells containing actors and a background.

Actor.create: Creates an actor without a world.
Actor.world: Containing world; throws if the actor has no world.
Actor.x: Column in cells; limited to the world bounds.
Actor.y: Row in cells; limited to the world bounds.
Actor.rotation: Heading in degrees: 0 is right, clockwise.
Actor.isAtEdge: Whether the actor is at the world edge; requires a world.
Actor.isClicked: Whether this actor was clicked; requires a world.
Actor.act: Override to define what happens on each step.
Actor.move: Moves in the current heading, in cells.
Actor.distanceTo: Distance to another actor, in cells.
Actor.intersects: Whether visible image pixels overlap; both actors require a world.
Actor.getIntersecting: All overlapping actors of type T; requires a world.
Actor.getOneIntersecting: One overlapping actor of type T, or null; requires a world.
Actor.isTouching: Whether an actor of type T overlaps; requires a world.
Actor.removeTouching: Removes one overlapping actor of type T; requires a world.
Actor.summary: A figure with a position, heading and image.

Image.setColor: Drawing color; RGB values from 0 to 255.
Image.drawLine: Draws a line between two points.
Image.drawImage: Draws a copy of another image at (x, y).
Image.scale: Scales to the given size in pixels.
Image.summary: A picture or drawing surface, measured in pixels.

BluePlayFunctions.isKeyDown: Whether the named key is held down.
BluePlayFunctions.step: Runs one step while the simulation is paused.
BluePlayFunctions.playSound: Plays a WAV file from sounds/.
BluePlayFunctions.summary: Functions for input, sound and simulation control.
